parts.method: Intact 1024-square source polygons; rigid transforms; exact bind registration.

sourceMeasurement.method: Fresh full-size source artwork measurement, pixel coordinates converted /1024; no old atlas anchors reused.

nearLeftMeasuredSupport.note: Knee is the black housing directly below the cream plate; ankle is the dark cuff at the top of the planted paw, not the outer side of the foot. The inner gold toe remains foot-owned behind the crusher.

occludedSupportGeometry.image_left_rear: Hip (606,638) and knee (591,707) are constrained estimates under the intact body/jaw, not illustrated extra anatomy; only visible lower-leg and actual sole pixels move. Very small supported load/recovery motion; no rear-leg walk.

stageSupport.behavior: contact soles remain at their measured stage sockets; flying Chime deliberately releases ground support

action.name: Set four supports, load the crusher, drive a weighted slam and recover

bastion.anatomyNotes: Actual five-prong crusher is one manufactured assembly on its native upper bar. Four support soles, true near-front sockets and ankle centers; rear-left hip/knee are honestly marked as occluded estimates. No invented anatomy or exposed missing upper rear limb; gait is brace/load/slam rather than walking. Rear layers are behind the complete native crusher silhouette.
